recommendations.reason: The full selecting source explains early doorway retention and ranged preemption, but no validated safe replacement is established. A focused repair needs a contemporaneous admitted caster shot, bounded approach, or contact-breaking route accounting for guard pull, current and remembered threats, impairment, hazards, health and hunger costs. Existing summoner approach scoring counts melee adjacency and does not itself certify safety against guard control. Validate earlier selections in a source-pinned reconstruction before probing alternatives on copies; stop at the first divergence. Neither extra charges, unknown potion identities, nor simply moving summoner priority earlier supplies that evidence.

review.review: The initiating episode was a mixed guard and necromancer encounter, not the final fallback alone. Decisions 3005–3007 (lines 8570–8575) attack the guard while the summoner is visible; the melee transition loses 15 HP. After healing and retreat, decisions 3010–3019 retain a doorway and attack its summoned skeleton. Decision 3020 (lines 8610–8611) loses the choke through displacement with a public guard-pull announcement. At decision 3024 (lines 8620–8622), ranged survival finds no admitted action despite six charges in a separate wand; a charged wand does not prove a clear shot. Fallback spends the last dew, then retreat and combat exhaust health and charges. Decision 3050 (lines 8707–8708) attacks an adjacent wounded skeleton at 1 HP; the accepted after-observation explicitly confirms death by bone explosion. The source chain is early preparation through tools/mage_policy.py:1098 and tools/doorway_tactics.py:42–129, then tools/ranged_tactics.py:196–250, with later summoner dispatch and eventual tools/continuation.py:34–64 fallback. Full source and logs resolve the selecting order and omitted resource observations, but do not establish an admitted replacement for the supported doorway encounter. No policy memory was reconstructed, no alternative was dispatched, and no post-death identities were treated as earlier knowledge. No patch or new regression is supplied: simply changing target priority or yielding to a route generator would not validate guard-control exposure and escape safety. The unchanged full Python suite passed 1,606 tests with four skips; this does not establish a safe alternative.
review.learnings: Separate a retained doorway from a resolved summoner encounter. Validate a bounded caster attack or contact-breaking alternative under guard-pull pressure before changing priorities. Known charges are not proof of a clear shot, and choosing preparation is not proof of puzzle completion.
